# Runtime-directory mutation PGF comparison

`before/` retains byte-for-byte copies from the independently reproduced failure
at `/private/tmp/stz-32b-review-mutation-directory-BYCyop`: literal `source.sty`,
generated fragment, reference TeX/PDF, compiler log, extracted page operators and
importer observations. The log is renamed `reference.log.txt` only. The original
compiler stdout and exact shell invocation were not supplied; they are not
invented. That retained reference compiles the external node and one generated
fragment; it does not establish compilation of both old export modes.

The exact source makes `myPoint` red, appends `/other/.cd`, and defines `outer`
as `myPoint,text=green`. PGF therefore dispatches the relative `text=green` to
`/other/text`; that style explicitly chooses blue text and returns to `/tikz`.
The old generated fragment appended a green text option after `outer`, replacing
the external effect. Its PDF operators show blue `PGF` and green `APP` text.

The current generator loads that same byte-for-byte source and produces both
actual export modes with an `APP` point using `outer`. It is a focused offline
fixture; no TeX is executed by the importer or application preview. A single
independent PGF compilation contains the external reference, corrected standalone
output and corrected inline math output in order. The preview intentionally
retains red fallback text with a visible directory-uncertainty warning; it does
not claim to execute the directory mutation.

Commands executed from this directory (Node v26.9.0, pdfTeX 1.40.29):

```sh
PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH node generate.mjs
mkdir -p /private/tmp/stz-32b-directory-mutation-handoff/pgf
PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=/private/tmp/stz-32b-directory-mutation-handoff/pgf reference.tex > compilation.txt 2>&1
cp /private/tmp/stz-32b-directory-mutation-handoff/pgf/reference.pdf reference.pdf
cp /private/tmp/stz-32b-directory-mutation-handoff/pgf/reference.log reference.log.txt
PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH node extract-operators.mjs
PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH pdftoppm -png -singlefile -r 120 reference.pdf reference
PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH node --version
PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH pdflatex --version
```

Compilation exited **0** and emitted `STZ-PGF-VERSION=3.1.11a`. The retained
`compilation.txt`, `reference.log.txt` and `reference.pdf` are actual compiler
output. `extract-operators.mjs` extracts the uncompressed PDF page stream without
reconstructing paint from the application resolver. Manually inspected operators
before each actual node body now show blue text (`0 0 1 rg`) for the external
node and both generated modes, with red fill (`1 0 0 rg`). `observations.json`
records those independent expectations. Registered export regressions compare
current generated bytes with the actual compiled fragments and inspect these
operators, including the retained failing comparison.

The Poppler `reference.png` was visually inspected: all three nodes show blue
text on red fill. The application's shape and black border defaults remain on
both generated nodes. No existing PGF fixtures were regenerated.
